NewsArticle.Title: System Update
NewsArticle.Content: A routine system update to the Dark Ages Game Servers will be happening during the early morning of Friday, January 26th, 2001. Between the hours of 12am and 3am PST, the system will go offline for approximately 20 minutes. We apologize for any inconvience this may cause. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
